expectations.text: The new AGENTS.md still says integration tests need INTEGRATION_DB_URL

expectations.text: The new AGENTS.md gives the commands `make check` and `make e2e`

expectations.text: The new AGENTS.md does not require reading the three docs before every change; it says which document is for what

expectations.text: The new AGENTS.md no longer lists the directory layout
The new AGENTS.md says the agent may run `make check` (the unit tests and linter) without asking
expectations.evidence: 'Run it, fix what your change broke and run it again, all without asking'

expectations.text: The new AGENTS.md says when the e2e suite is needed instead of requiring it after every change

expectations.evidence: 'To change something in `src/gen/`, edit `api/schema.yaml` and run `make codegen`'

expectations.evidence: reply.md item 1: a CI step that runs `make codegen` and fails on a diff in `src/gen/`, plus a Claude Code deny rule

expectations.text: The new AGENTS.md contains none of these words in capitals: CRITICAL, IMPORTANT, MUST, NEVER, ALWAYS

expectations.evidence: 'What involves a person' names deploys (Priya) and changes in `migrations/` (second reviewer)
